scripts.dev:api:server: cd apps/api && ENV_FILE=../../.env.server npm run start:dev
scripts.dev:api:production: cd apps/api && ENV_FILE=../../.env.production npm run start:dev
scripts.kill:9001: lsof -ti:9001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'No process found on port 9001'
scripts.kill:9000: lsof -ti:9000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'No process found on port 9000'
scripts.kill:4100: lsof -ti:4100 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'No process found on port 4100'
scripts.prod:status: ps aux | grep -E '(npm|node)' | grep -v grep || echo 'No production processes found'
scripts.prod:logs: echo 'Production logs are in the terminal where npm run dev:production was started'
scripts.prod:stop: pkill -f 'npm run dev:production' || echo 'No production processes to stop'
scripts.prod:restart: npm run prod:stop && sleep 2 && npm run dev:production
